Final-year Bachelor's and First-Year Master's student in Civil Engineering at Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM), passionate about shaping the built environment through innovative, sustainable solutions. My interests span optimum structure design, Finite Element Analysis, seismic analysis, bridge design, applied math, and programming for civil engineering.

My academic journey has also led me to develop a strong foundation in mathematics, physics, and technical design, complemented by hands-on experience in projects, lecturer assistance, seminars, and coursework.

In addition to my technical interests, I value collaboration, problem-solving, and lifelong learning. I actively seek opportunities to enhance my knowledge and contribute to projects that make a positive impact on society.

If you are looking for a dedicated and detail-oriented team member with a curiosity for innovation and a commitment to excellence, I would love to connect and collaborate
